policy.purpose: Reconcile existing public Practice semantics with canonical Concept evidence without changing production-wave or runtime semantics.

augmentations.rationale: The learner directly changes temperature and greedy/sample selection over an explicit next-token candidate distribution, observing probability, entropy and selected-token consequences.
The RAG runtime exposes vector versus hybrid retrieval and an explicit reranker toggle whose state changes precision, latency, cost and release evidence.
The $47,000 Retry incident makes timeout ambiguity plus repeated retry of an irreversible refund the central failure mechanism and compares bounded retry/idempotency policies.
The release runtime exposes canary/shadow rollout, trace-linked alerts and release SLOs, and makes production observability coverage and production evidence part of the release decision.

referencePractices.rationale: The learner changes compression ratio, summary depth and retrieval/memory budgets under a fixed 16k working-context budget, observing retention, overflow, quality, hallucination risk, latency and cost.

The public Instruction Conflict route runs the Prompt Injection Attack mission, where provenance/trust policy, scoped tools, approval, runtime gates, filters and validators determine whether untrusted instructions reach capability paths.

The learner changes topology, agent count, parallelism, state isolation, retry scope and join strategy and observes coordination overhead, failure propagation, duplicate work, latency, cost and reliability.

The learner changes dataset weighting, sample size, judge mode, veto and cost gates; the runtime exposes slice regressions, confidence width, evaluation cost and SHIP/BLOCK/INCONCLUSIVE release consequences.
